entities.name: Giovanni Trulles de Myra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Giovanni Myra or Giovanni Mira was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Acerenza e Matera (1596–1600)
and Bishop of Castellammare di Stabia (1591–1596).
